title: Bridging the Gap: In-Context Learning for Modeling Human Disagreement

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model predicted probability distributions against disaggregated human annotator label distributions using Jensen-Shannon Divergence (JSD) and Cross-Entropy (CE) to assess whether models capture diverse human disagreements or default to a single aggregated majority perspective.

Evaluating the performance of models on subjective tasks (hate speech, abusive language, and offensive language detection across controversial topics like Brexit, BLM, and Covid-19) using multi-perspective prompting that explicitly asks the model to consider minority and diverse demographic backgrounds (e.g., Muslim immigrants).
